mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_quiz (user_id, knowledge_base_id, title, topic, difficulty, question_count, types_json, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{title}, #{topic}, #{difficulty}, #{questionCount}, #{typesJson}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, knowledge_base_id, title, topic, difficulty, question_count, types_json, status, score, correct_count, wrong_count, analysis, error_message, create_time, update_time, submitted_at FROM sa_quiz WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_quiz SET status = 'READY', error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE sa_quiz SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE sa_quiz SET status = 'COMPLETED', score = #{score}, correct_count = #{correctCount}, wrong_count = #{wrongCount}, analysis = #{analysis}, submitted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'READY'
